info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights consensus_ratings API

params.name: parameters[date_from]
params.description: Date to query from point in time

params.name: parameters[date_to]
params.description: Date to query to point in time

params.name: parameters[tickers]
params.description: One ticker symbol to query the aggregate for. Maximum 1 ticker

params.name: simplify
params.description: To simplify the aggregate ratings to only BUY, SELL, HOLD, default will return all ratings (STRONG_BUY, BUY, HOLD, SELL, STRONG_SELL)

params.name: aggregate_type
params.description: To aggregate the ratings by either number or percentage

items.docs: Returns aggregated consensus analyst ratings data for a given ticker symbol. This endpoint provides consensus price targets, aggregate ratings distribution, and analyst counts based on recent analyst ratings.
